items.title: 25.4 Dawa sazi mein artificial intelligence (AI) ka istemal (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichhli chand dahaiyon (decades) mein bohat kam naye antibiotics bane hain, aur jo bane woh pehle se maujood antibiotics se thore hi mukhtalif hain. Nayi dawaiyan banane ke maujooda tareeqe bohat mehnge aur waqt lene wale hain, aur aam tor par chemical activity ke tang daire (narrow spectrum) tak mehdood hain. Saath hi aise cases barh rahe hain jin mein bimari phailane wale jaraseem (pathogens) aam antibiotics ke khilaf resistant (mazahmat karne wale) ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka jumla ulta hai: “prevalent antibiotics become resistant to existing pathogens”. Antibiotics resistant nahi hote; jaraseem (bacteria) antibiotics ke khilaf resistant ho jate hain.

blocks.alt: Halicin: paanch kone wale 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring par H2N (oopar ring ka S, neeche N-N), jo darmiyani S ke zariye paanch kone wale thiazole ring (oopar ring ka S, neeche baen N) se jura hai jis par NO2 hai.
blocks.caption: Halicin ki banawat (structure) (kitab ke PDF safha 142 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke halicin khaake mein dono paanch kone wale rings ki oopar wali chotti par koi atom nahi likha, jis se lagta hai wahan carbon hai. Asal mein halicin ke dono rings mein wahan sulphur (S) hai: baen taraf 1,3,4-thiadiazole ring aur daen taraf thiazole ring. Is liye hamare khaake mein dono rings mein S likha gaya hai; beech wala S dono rings ko jorta hai.

Is masle ka hal dhoondne ke liye MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) ke researchers ne aik machine-learning algorithm banaya jo un chemical khasiyaton ko dhoonde jo molecules ko E. coli bacteria maarne mein kaamyab banati hain. Is ke liye unhon ne model ko 2500 molecules aur 800 qudrati (natural) products ke aik set par chalaya, jin ke structures mukhtalif aur biological asraat (bioactivities) wasee the. Jab computer model in compounds par chalaya gaya to us ne aik aisa molecule chuna jis ke bare mein andaza tha ke woh bacteria ko maarega aur jis ka structure maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif hai.

Aik doosre model se researchers ne yeh bhi dikhaya ke yeh molecule insani cells ke liye ghaliban kam zehreela (low toxicity) hoga. Baad mein is molecule ka naam Halicin rakha gaya aur ise mareezon se liye gaye bacteria ki kai qismon (strains) par aazmaya gaya. Pata chala ke is naye molecule ne duniya ke bohat se mushkil tareen bimari phailane wale bacteria maar diye jin par pehle ilaaj asar nahi karta tha.

Halicin pehchanne ke baad researchers ne apne computer model se aik database ke 10 crore (100 million) se zyada molecules jaanche (screen kiye). Yeh jaanch sirf teen din mein mukammal hui, aur model ne 23 mazeed aise molecules chune jin ke structures maujooda antibiotics se mukhtalif hain. Researchers ne dekha ke in mein se aath molecules ne bacteria ke khilaf asar dikhaya aur do khaas tor par taqatwar the. Is kaam ne dawa ke tor par istemal ho sakne wale naye organic molecules dhoondne ka bilkul naya raasta dikhaya hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Vitamin B₁₂ ki tareekhi mukammal (total) synthesis R. B. Woodward aur A. Eschenmoser ne 1972 mein 10 saal se zyada ke ishtirak (collaboration) ke baad ki. Is mein 100 se zyada steps the, aur 91 post-doctoral researchers aur 12 PhD students ne kaam kiya.

blocks.prompt: AI model ne kya kaam kiya jo lab mein aazmane se bohat dair leta?
blocks.explanation: Is ne bohat bari tadaad mein molecules ka bacteria maarne wala asar (aur mumkina zehreela-pan) pehle se andaze se bataya, teen din mein 10 crore se zyada molecules jaanche, aur lab mein aazmane ke liye Halicin jaise chand umeedwar chune.

items: Naye antibiotics kam ban rahe hain aur bacteria ki resistance barh rahi hai.
MIT ke machine-learning model ne Halicin dhoonda, jo resistant bacteria ko maarta hai.
3 din mein 10 crore se zyada molecules ki jaanch: 23 umeedwar, 8 asar wale, 2 bohat taqatwar.
